title: Skillarum: Conditionally Reproducible Website-to-Agent-Skill Compilation
description: The selected Skillarum manuscript describes a five-stage pipeline that compiles selected server-rendered website pages into portable SKILL.md artifacts with provenance, resumability and explicit provider/fallback histories. Its current report summarizes 538 persisted observations from three source profiles and 535 target bundles. A reported 100% package-valid rate applies only to completed runs and is not an end-to-end success probability or population estimate. Human-review agreement is pending, and this catalog refresh does not rerun or independently validate those observations.
